    33	        return {
    34	            "ai_name": self.ai_name,
    35	            "identity": self.identity,
    36	            "personality": self.personality,
    37	            "model_config": self.model_config,
    38	            "memory": self.memory,

    45	        self.identity = data.get("identity", {"created": False})
    46	        self.personality = data.get("personality", {})

    51	    def is_complete(self) -> bool:
